# Verify final state against all requirements before finishing
import subprocess

# Check commits on base
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.')
commits = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"Commits on base: {len(commits)}")
for c in commits:
    print(f"  {c}")

# Run tests
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
     '--ignore=tests/test_mru.py', '-k', 'not MRU', 'tests/'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print(f"\nTests: {result.stdout.strip().split(chr(10))[-1]}")
print(f"Exit code: {result.returncode}")

# Verify public names
import cachetools
import cachetools.func

# m1
assert 'cached' in dir(cachetools), "cached missing"
assert 'cachedmethod' in dir(cachetools), "cachedmethod missing"
print("\nm1: cached and cachedmethod present ✓")

# m2
for name in ['fifo_cache', 'lfu_cache', 'lru_cache', 'rr_cache', 'ttl_cache']:
    assert name in dir(cachetools.func), f"{name} missing"
print("m2: all func decorators present ✓")

# m3
assert 'MRUCache' not in dir(cachetools), "MRUCache should be removed"
assert 'mru_cache' not in dir(cachetools.func), "mru_cache should be removed"
print("m3: MRUCache and mru_cache removed ✓")

print("\nAll requirements verified!")
